snippet.title: Dinocop - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description: Check out the release date trailer for Dinocop, a dark comedic detective adventure set in a world where humans and dinosaurs coexist. Players step into the role of Dinocop, a reluctant dinosaur officer created by humans after every other dino refused to join the force. Dinocop is launching on November 6 for PC (Steam) with a demo available now on Steam.
